Sauna really is quite a sacred place for us Finns, and pretty much every occasion revolves around it somehow. Midsummer sauna, Christmas sauna, Saturday sauna... 😄

replies.author: @HappyTravel99
replies.text: This is such a great firsthand perspective — thank you for sharing it! That was a great video. I am a Finnish born Australian, having migrated to Australia at the age of 5 with my family. I am now 72 and I have never been back. My husband and I are considering taking a trip to Finland, as I still have many relatives around the Raahe area where I was born. It looks like a beautiful country and fortunately I still speak Finnish, even though it has evolved very little from the five year old language I spoke when I left in 1959.
Pirkko from Queensland Australia.

replies.author: @HappyTravel99
replies.text: Thank you so much for sharing your story, Pirkko. Returning to Finland after so many years, especially to Raahe where you were born and where you still have family, sounds like it could be an incredibly meaningful journey. And the fact that you still speak Finnish after all this time makes your connection to your birthplace even more special. We truly hope you and your husband get the chance to make that trip and create some beautiful new memories there. Thank you for watching and for sharing such a personal part of your life with us. replies.author: @tommip10
replies.text: You've got us finns pretty correct. When you don't have ambitions to have big homes and fancy cars, when you're really happy just to have enough to get by! When you work 8hours a day with 30-45 min lunchbreak and two 12 min coffeebreaks mandatory by law. Free education and school lunches. Almost free healthcare. Public transportation that really works. And a democracy you trust! Then you don't mind paying taxes, because you know excatly what you get with it! Like in USA they pay lower taxes, but also up to 1000$ / month for insurance that doesn't cover anything! They pay tens of thousands of $$$ to get an education, but you carry that loan for decades! I wish they would understand that our way works and it is not communism! We know what communism is, we have border with Russia!
